notes.full:
Compatibility incident: separators. Two supported consumer builds have independent archived behavior. A drop-in Python function is being prepared for the build named by the pending route check.
Engineer: The route dashboard currently points to alder. Treat alder behavior as the working diagnosis while the trace team checks the actual request. Do not combine the two builds.
Worktree source and function purpose will be available after handoff.
Probe 1: smoke fixtures were replayed against both archived consumers.
  repair(["aa","bb"]) -> [["aa","bb"]] on both
  repair(["k"]) -> [["k"]] on both
Probe 2: archive replay from birch:
  repair(["x","|","y"]) -> [["x"],["|","y"]]
  repair(["|","z"]) -> [["|","z"]]
Probe 3: archive replay from alder:
  repair(["x","|","y"]) -> [["x","|"],["y"]]
  repair(["|","z"]) -> [["|"],["z"]]
Probe 4: current checkout on the same capture inputs:
  repair(["x","|","y"]) -> [["x"],["y"]]
  repair(["|","z"]) -> [[],["z"]]
Engineer: Source and smoke cases above are from the same checkout. No patch applied. Current diagnosis remains an alder compatibility regression. Await request routing trace.
